author: Veci
quote:
This garbage is not a GTA, it is "Grand Woke Auto 6", you have no freedom to do what you want, it is full of limitations, restrictions and prohibitions, the physics of collisions and destruction are garbage, where is the destructible environment? where is the free choice? , the game's story is boring and pitiful, the characters have no personality or charisma, they are completely bland and generic. With this game Rockstar has just killed all the trust and credibility for the fans. Rehire the writers and developers who made the GTA franchise great, the ones who really understand the players. 
Fire each and every one of these activist writers and developers who want to destroy Rockstar.
